name: print-social-black-green-glass-card-ninety-two-percent-carousel-post
title: Grow Your Profit 92% Glass Card Slide
whatItIs: A black carousel slide with a centred logo above a large rounded glass card with a green glow at the right edge, a segmented progress bar, the heading 'Grow Your Profit With Us', a giant white 92% with a green arrow, a paragraph and a Learn more pill; above it the base of a blue slide with an email and Swipe >>, and below a lime notebook-tab card.
whatItMeans: One huge number and a glowing card make a claim feel confident, and the story-style progress bar shows the swipe.
techniques: Huge stat with a small growth arrow
Green glow bleeding into a glass card
Segmented progress bar at the card top
Small paragraph and outlined pill at the base
Black canvas around a single card

vocabulary.definition: A slide built around one big figure.
A small upward arrow beside a percentage.
A row of dashes showing position in a sequence.
